attributes.action: Make using the likeness of and/or involving children in sexual videos illegal
attributes.additional_details: Whilst our country currently has some laws surrounding non contact child sexual abuse the currently guidelines to uphold this as listed with CPS are broad/poorly defined. An uprise in inappropriate conduct with children has appeared online so I implore you make it illegal to involve any child/likeness of a child to be featured in any video discussing, suggesting or preluding to future sexual behaviours/ make it illegal to promote sexual material on pages that also contain videos of children.
attributes.background: Amongst current UK laws and legislations surrounding no contact child sexual assault the wording is currently broad and with poor defined limits. I want a law to be passed that prohibits minors/ likeness of minors to be involved, in any capacity, in videos which discuss or suggest future sex content

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Ban children & their likeness being used to promote pornography or adult-content
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781598
